record.label: Probability-one recovery of the marked set
record.statement: Find-All terminates with probability one and outputs all $k$ elements of $S$.
record.boundary: For $n=3$ and $S=\{1,6\}$, both $49$ and $14$ decode to $S$. Their two base-$8$ digits are $1$ and $6$ in opposite orders. At $k=1$, both tasks recover the single marked index. Find-All states the postcondition using a decoded set.
